article_notes: 15 dogs with uncomplicated B. canis babesiosis (all recovered) vs 7 healthy dogs. Every comparison (WBC, RBC, Ht, PLT, Cu, Zn, SOD, CAT, GSH) is infected vs healthy; all infected dogs were uncomplicated, so there are no severity or outcome groups. Statement of no correlation between 18S strain type and antioxidant markers is not against severity. Clinic type not stated.
